A headless run tries to confirm its own stop, and the guard refuses the edit
Dynamic View: Factory Flow Control - Validator
reads one tool call as its CLI passes
it and, for a write, the current
content of the target; refuses a call
that sets a human field in
CLI, and Pi or patch in OpenCode,
reads the paths and lines from the
patch text and refuses a patch it
cannot parse when the raw text
names a guarded path; exits 0 to
pass and 2 to refuse; an agent that
hides the field name, such as by
building it from pieces in a script,
